name: Our Eleven: Shape & Shared Jobs
concept: Understand the goalkeeper and each line, then adapt midfield support as a fullback advances.
desc: Your team has eleven players: one goalkeeper and ten outfield players. Attack the far goal and protect the goal behind your keeper.

steps.say: Your team has eleven players: one goalkeeper and ten outfield players. Attack the far goal and protect the goal behind your keeper.

steps.desc: The right fullback receives. The next supporting job is on this side.
